title: HumynexSurg-1: A Curated Expert Liposuction Dataset
abstract: arXiv:2609.23885v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robot foundation models learn manipulation from large demonstration corpora, but surgery is missing from those corpora: across the 780-hour Open-H surgical collection, one dataset carries synchronized force and none covers an aesthetic procedure. Liposuction is the hard case, because the instrument works under the skin and the surgeon operates by feel and by judgment. Humynex Robotics builds curated expert datasets for this kind of procedure. HumynexSurg-1 is the first release: a master liposuction surgeon performing on porcine abdominal tissue while narrating every decision, recorded with synchronized suction pressure, six-axis hand force/torque, top-down RGB-D video, side video and a lavalier microphone -- 14 episodes, 42,738 frames, 35.6 minutes, 356 utterances of which 95% compile into a liposuction-specific label schema. translated_title: HumynexSurg-1：一个精心策划的专家级吸脂手术数据集
translated_abstract: 机器人基础模型从大型演示语料库中学习操作技能，但这些语料库中缺少手术数据：在整个780小时的Open-H手术数据集中，只有一个数据集包含同步的力数据，且没有一个涵盖美容手术。吸脂术是其中的难点案例，因为器械在皮肤下操作，外科医生依靠触觉和判断进行手术。Humynex Robotics正是为此类手术构建精心策划的专家数据集。HumynexSurg-1是首个发布版本：一位资深吸脂外科医生在猪腹部组织上进行手术，同时对每个决策进行语音讲解，记录内容包括同步的吸引压力、六轴手部力/力矩、俯视RGB-D视频、侧面视频和领夹式麦克风录音——共14个片段、42,738帧、35.6分钟、356条语音讲解，其中95%可编译为吸脂专用标签模式。数据采集遵循一项正在申请专利的传感方案，该方案围绕策略所需的物理量进行组织，因此一个通道
tldr: 发布首个专家级吸脂手术数据集HumynexSurg-1，通过同步采集吸引压力、六轴力/力矩、RGB-D视频等多模态传感数据及语音讲解标注，填补了机器人基础模型训练语料中美容手术数据的空白。
en_tdlr: HumynexSurg-1 is the first curated expert liposuction dataset with synchronized multimodal sensing (suction pressure, six-axis force/torque, RGB-D video) and narrated decision-making, filling the gap of aesthetic procedures in robot foundation model training corpora.
